priorityList: Cast Whirlwind if the Whirlwind cleave buff is missing.
Use Recklessness and Avatar together on cooldown.
Cast Rampage if you are near max Rage (110+) or if Enrage is about to expire.
Use Bladestorm while Enraged, ideally during Recklessness.
Cast Execute if Sudden Death procs.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active to dump Rage.
Cast Bloodthirst to generate Rage and Enrage.
Maintain Rend if the duration is under 6 seconds.
Cast Execute on targets in health range (below 20% or 35% with Massacre).
Cast Rampage as a general filler to maintain Enrage.
Cast Whirlwind as a filler to maintain cleave stacks and generate Rage.
